visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short brown hair sits in a curved wooden chair against a plain white wall. The drawer contains rows of dark red packets; one is selected. (3) Hands tear the top of the red packet and pour fine white powder into a clear glass of water on a wooden table. The woman then drinks the mixture while looking directly at the camera. (4) White powder is poured onto a dark circular plate. A product box labeled "AGENDA GWL Probiotics Heritage" is displayed on a wooden shelf next to a glass of water. (5) The woman, now wearing a white sleeveless knit top, stands in a brightly lit room with wooden shelves. She holds the product box and smiles warmly while drinking water. (6) She is seen sitting on the floor leaning against a white wall with a large white bolster pillow, appearing pensive. A subsequent shot shows her looking into a mirror, gently touching her cheeks and eye area. (7) She walks across a city crosswalk wearing a white knit dress and a beige shoulder bag. Modern glass buildings and street signs are visible in the bright daylight background. (8) Close-up of the woman pouring the contents of a red packet directly into her mouth while outdoors. (9) She puts a red packet into a beige leather handbag on a white table and zips the compartment closed. (10) Final shot shows the woman walking away on a sunny street, then turning back to smile brightly at the camera with her hand near her face.
